title: Asher's first words to J: tune into my heart

tellings.quote: the first thing Asher said to J was like tune into my heart

plain: A child named Asher, one of the nonspeaking children said in the documentary The Telepathy Tapes to read minds, is said to have told someone called J as his very first words, "tune into my heart." Ky Dickens, who made the documentary, tells Michels this from what she was told: "the first thing Asher said to J was like tune into my heart." If true, it would suggest these children communicate by something deeper than speech.
